trainable: decoder layers 20-27, final norm, candidate head
loss: soft cross-entropy + 0.1 * Brier, mean over questions; Typed Decisions replay in every step
wording: each sampled gate request reworded by coding_gates/wordings.vary (each question keeps its original wording with probability 0.25)
selection: Evaluate step 0 and every eval_every steps on gate dev and Typed Decisions dev. A step is eligible if its Typed Decisions dev soft CE <= step 0's + 0.01. Choose the eligible step with the lowest gate dev soft CE (mean over every gate dev question, including each request's gate asked again in the evaluate.PARAPHRASES wordings); ties go to the earlier step. Test splits and FINAL_PARAPHRASES are not read.
